review_design.sampling_rule: hash ordered by stable source object id, exclude both original queues, no score/label-based selection, select 8 per each of 4 strata; hold out 32 from first review and any subsequent tuning until separate freeze
review_design.classification: risk-enriched 44 (25 old-only and 19 current); stratified 32 current-model development holdout. Not a population estimate or confirmatory gold.

FUSION.ranks: stored pool_rank for original; fixed RRF k60 for extension

TYPED_QUESTION.ranks: exclude prior RED and new explicit conflicts, held scope or unregistered role; prioritize complete source/target surface or authored whole-label bilingual pair, then stored fusion rank; remaining mismatched labels are UNRESOLVED_REVIEW_QUESTION, not accepted relations

rank_scopes: per source and target scope; original scopes and extension reported separately; no cross-batch score merge

residual_patch.rice_alias: registered whole label as candidate-search evidence only; Chinese implicit cooking state remains unconfirmed and yields a question
residual_patch.peeled: explicit peeled/unpeeled/去皮/带皮 opposed, negation-aware, new proposal blocks conflict without altering R1
residual_patch.expert: v0.3 response schema contradictions, no actual expert assignment; phase-B per-edge binding/ACL remains blocked until EA-P0

metric_plan.coverage: proposals per query and scopes; not accuracy
metric_plan.review_reference_hit: At least one independently proposed native target in top k among cases with verified target in same frozen target universe; development reference overlap not true recall
metric_plan.absence: separate no target found, insufficient source, target outside universe, target in universe but absent pool, in pool but outside shortlist, blocked/unknown; do not prove absence
metric_plan.precision: requires independent pair judgment of all sampled proposed edges for a declared relation/purpose, with unresolved separately retained; cannot infer from source-only target list
metric_plan.thresholds: fixed top k for development; independent confirmatory protocol needs expert reference and PI-approved margin/sample plan before open

reviewer: prefer separate fresh reviewer not exposed to actual new candidate rows; Gemini if used declares prior method exposure, developmental only; no confirmed ACL
